notes.title: Update News!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

With this update, you can place the tables where ever you want! also we made some balance for early stage of the game.Lets have a peek!

-Addiction level

+Addiction level multiplies your casino earnings.
+When your customers win any game, the addiction level goes up.
+When your customers lose any game, the addiction level goes down a little.
+You have to becarefull about managing your table win rates for that.

-Construction mode

+You can place the tables where ever you want.
+This is for only Roulettes, Blackjacks, Craps and Slots

-Balance

+We made addiction level for balancing the early stage of the game.With this feature, you will earn more.
+Decreased the dirt effect for prestige loss.
+Increased the dirt time for prestige loss.
+Crypto minimum and maximum buy/sell amount balanced.

-Others

+Minor and major bug fixes.
+Working on the new casino building for better game visuals.
+Small optimizing for better performance.

Thats all for now everyone!
Hold still and make sure you have added your wishlist the game before release!
If you have any questions or ideas please feel free to contact us!

contact mail : batuhanguner@crackedbonestudios.com

notes.title: News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you all doing well.There is some new features on Casino Tycoon Simulator and we want to show them to you guys.

1-)Revenue/Loss Panel
-You can see how much money you have spented on car/casino/crypto/nightclub and how much you have earned so far.You can see this panel on your office desk.

2-)Nighclub
-We are still developing the nightclub feature.Soon it will be finished and we are going to announce it with a trailer.

3-)Casino Name
-Now you can give a name to your casino! Name can be changed on main menu and you can see it in game scene next to the main entrence.

4-)Casino placement
-We decided to change casino site.New settlement is going to be more shiny and bigger than current one.

Thats all for now.If you have any questions or requests please feel free to contact us via e-mail.We care about your thinkings.

Contact: batuhanguner@crackedbonestudios.com

notes.title: Changes On Pub
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We made some changes on Pub mechanics.Now you can make stock of your products!
Before the service you have to open Stock panel and buy stock of what you wish to service.
If you dont have any stock of the product that you want to service, game wont let you to take it.

With this update we tried to make game more reallistic.
Also you can use your pub on NightClub too! 

Soon we are going to post more about the NightClub Update when we are ready!

See you all on next update announcements and stay healthy!

Batuhan Güner

For contact: batuhan.gner@gmail.com
